title: Bombay High Court quashes Bank of India’s ‘fraud’ tag on Kishore and Rakesh Biyani
description: The Bombay High Court has set aside Bank of India’s decision to classify the accounts of Kishore and Rakesh Biyani, promoters of Future Lifestyle Fashions Ltd (FLFL), as 'fraud' [Kishore Biyani & Anr v. Bank of India & Anr].A division bench of Justices BP Colabawalla and Firdosh P Pooniwalla held that the bank’s order lacked reasons and breached the Reserve Bank of India’s 2024 Fraud Master Directions.The order was passed on a plea by the Biyani brothers challenging Bank of India’s order
